_comment: Hand-curated. Every photo was looked at and its label read before being listed here. 'exact': the label names this list entry. 'family': the label shows the brand but not which of the listed variants; the page says so. Descriptions attach to every brand whose name contains one of the 'match' strings; check what a new match string catches before adding it. Run python scripts/fetch_media.py after editing.
